items.title: "This is clearly how it ends. The machine just recursively optimizes its own weights"
items.summary:
"This is clearly how it ends. The machine just recursively optimizes its own weights"

the paper's lead author: "I think so too. Not just own weights. Any other weights!"

GPT-6 Astra edited 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights and took its math score from 7.9% to 48.1%, with ZERO gradients

instead of fine-tuning, it traced the model's reasoning loops to one direction inside two layers and edited those exact weights directly

it even wrote a Breakout network from scratch, no data and no training, that scored 517 while PPO trained for 500M steps scored 25

plenty of labs have talked about RSI, but this is the first real sign of it I've seen

we're entering a very scary new era, AI is starting to improve AI

items.title: I used Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra to build a self-learning trading algorithm
items.summary:
I used Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra to build a self-learning trading algorithm

The result: +$2,786.41 in 9 days

1,508 launches tracked. 30,160 holders analyzed. 69 wallet clusters detected. Only 6 tokens passed every check, each scoring 85+/100

I MADE THE CORE SCORING CODE OPEN SOURCE (80+ STARS)

GitHub:https://t.co/vaBkwbtFMN

QUANTUMORB IS FULLY OPERATIONAL

- The website, RADAR, SCANNER, Tg bot and entire backend infrastructure are now live
- Hundreds of users are already using QuantumOrb daily

Three recent Solana launches:

Oct 30, 18:08 UTC: $WASTED launched → RADAR alert at 18:49 → 5.1x after the alert

Nov 2, 11:34 UTC: $MAMESUKE launched → RADAR alert at 12:16 → 7.6x after the alert

Nov 3, 21:21 UTC: $AMD launched → RADAR alert at 22:39 → 9.4x after the alert

Here’s how QuantumOrb works:

RADAR tracks new https://t.co/DVKX2i8Gnz launches, bonding curves, market caps and trading activity in real time

SHIELD checks creators before alerts go out. 10+ launches with fewer than 10% graduating? Flagged

SCANNER analyzes the top 20 holders and first 20 buyers, tracking wallet histories, entries and token distribution

CARTOGRAPHER detects connected wallets through shared token sources, same-transaction buys and transfers

GUARD investigates developer history, launch-slot accumulation and remaining dev holdings

ORB combines five risk signals into a 0–100 score and calculates potential selling impact using two models:

Risk Scoring Model

Score = S_operator + S_fresh + S_transfers + S_snipers + S_top20

The system evaluates hidden ownership, fresh wallets, transferred supply, early snipers and holder concentration

Price Impact Model

Impact = 1 − (R / (R + q))²

R = token reserves in the liquidity pool
q = tokens sold by connected wallets

The model estimates how much the price could fall if a linked group exits its positions

RADAR identifies potential runners. SCANNER reveals who’s actually behind them

One system. Real-time alerts. On-chain risk analysis.

QUANTUMORB IS LIVE

And we’re just getting started

items.title: Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions
items.summary:
DownloadDownload

Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved beyond answering questions and generating content. Increasingly, AI systems are being designed to act. Agentic AI can pursue objectives, make decisions and take actions on a user’s behalf, potentially with limited human involvement in individual decisions. [...] Consider a customer who gives an AI agent access to a bank account with an instruction to manage the customer’s cash efficiently. The agent decides to transfer funds, convert currencies or purchase an investment.

At first sight, these may appear to be ordinary customer transactions. Agentic AI, however, exposes important distinctions between identity, authentication, authority and attribution. [...] As agentic AI becomes more capable, firms may increasingly encounter interactions in which an AI agent collects information, compares products and initiates transactions for a customer. That creates a new layer between the institution and the person or entity with whom it has established a customer relationship.

items.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips | TechCrunch
items.summary:
The chip launch comes as hyperscalers like Microsoft, Amazon, and even AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are working on their own lines of AI-specific semiconductors and accompanying software in order to reduce their reliance on the dominance of Nvidia.

The news also comes at a particularly vulnerable moment for Nvidia, whose CEO Jensen Huang over the weekend admitted to having an affair with someone alleged to be a Chinese spy. [...] Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package. The result is a chip that lets AI models handle a larger range of information during queries. [...] TPU 8tx, designed with AMD, is based on the TPU 8t chip, and is geared specifically for confidentially training and running AI models, Google said in a blog post. The chip “builds security directly into the hardware layer, keeping sensitive data and model weights protected and isolated even while in active use,” the company wrote.
